rules.name: En-dash between date ranges in various formats with slash ending with year (1898 or 89 or ’89)
rules.description: En-dash without spaces between date ranges in various formats (1/2/2020–1/3/2026). Many other forms are supported (1–2 April 2025, 1/X–2/XII or 1/9–10/9/’87)

rules.name: Spaces around en-dash in various date ranges (1.1.2023 – 31.12.2024)
rules.description: For date ranges, an en-dash separated by spaces is used (unlike ranges expressed with cardinal numbers)

rules.name: Fix Dublin 6W instead of incorrect 6 W
rules.description: Fix Dublin 6W instead of incorrect 6 W which means 6 Watt

examples.before: The Dublin 6 W designation is unusual.

rules.name: Alert: two capital letters at the beginning of a word
rules.description: Two capital letters are not written consecutively at the beginning of a sentence or certain words. However, exceptions may be made for company names, product names, service names, or intentional neologisms.

examples.before:
EXample of the PRoblem. (Incorrect English)
Example of the Problem. (Correct English)

rules.name: Alert: two consecutive identical parentheses or brackets
rules.description: Two identical parentheses in a row are usually incorrect; one of them may be superfluous. However, they may be secondary parentheses, which should have a different form. Or perhaps everything is fine in this particular context.

rules.name: Alert: sentence probably starts with lowercase letter
rules.description: The beginning of a sentence should start with a capital letter. However, it is possible that in a given context, the use of a lowercase letter is correct.

examples.before:
(Hello.) new sentence. (Incorrect English)
(Hello.) New sentence. (Correct English)
“Hi!” my name is Judy. (Incorrect English)
“Hi!” My name is Judy. (Correct English)
Filip, Linda atd. jsou kamarádi. (Correct Czech)

rules.name: Alert: a word followed by hyphen
rules.description: A word followed by hyphen could be intentional (Ein- oder Zweizimmerwohnung) or the hyphen could represent dash or hyphen with or without spaces depending on context and language.

examples.before:
Ein – oder Zweizimmerwohnung (German incorrect)
Ein- oder Zweizimmerwohnung (German correct)
Nosotros —o tú-. (Spanish incorrect)
Nosotros —o tú—. (Spanish correct)
Říkáš- li pravdu… (Czech incorrect)
Říkáš‑li pravdu… (Czech)
budynki jedno- i dwupiętrowe (Polish correct)
motywy staro- i nowotestamentowe (Polish correct)
kroje jedno- lub dwuelementowe (Polish correct)
układy jedno- i wielopoziomowe (Polish correct)
reakcje endo- lub egzotermiczne (Polish correct)
mono- i poligamia 
makro- i mikroekonomia 
elektro- i gazowe

rules.name: Alert: It is possible that this is an incorrectly typed expression “à la”
rules.description: It is possible that this is an incorrectly typed expression “à la” meaning “in the style of”

examples.before:
Kuře alá bažant (Czech)
Kuře á la bažant (Czech)
Kuře alà bažant (Czech)

rules.name: Alert: Two initials connected with hyphen
rules.description: Two initials connected by a hyphen can mean “from–to,” in which case they should be written with a dash.

rules.name: Alert: It is possible that the plus sign (+) is used instead of the † symbol for the date of death.
rules.description: It is possible that the plus sign (+) is used instead of the † symbol for the date of death.

examples.before:
(* 1928 Budapest, + 2023 Paris)
(+2023 in New York)
Georges Pompidou (+ 1968)
(The spaces between † and year may vary according local preferences.)
examples.after:
(* 1928 Budapest, † 2023 Paris)
(†2023 in New York)
Georges Pompidou († 1968)
(The spaces between † and year may vary according local preferences.)

rules.name: Nonbreaking space between numbers and all abbreviated or full length SI units incl. SI prefixes (20 mg, 3 mol)
rules.description: A non-breaking space is used between the value and the unit to prevent the expression from being split at the end of a line
